title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, REST API, and static web UI. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio using natural language queries.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec) and FastAPI for the backend. The frontend is a static HTML/JS application served from S3/CloudFront. It uses GitHub Actions for weekly reindexing and Lambda functions for OAuth handling.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, configure a GitHub Personal Access Token in .env, run the indexing command against your username, export the data to JSON, and serve the web directory locally or deploy to AWS S3/CloudFront.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env to add GITHUB_TOKEN
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Client-side semantic search using TF-IDF and embedding vectors
Automatic clustering of repositories into capability categories
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and star count
MCP server integration for AI agent access to portfolio data
Static web UI with shareable URLs and localStorage collections
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
